lines.zh: 我在熔岩里游，鳍边冒着火星。
lines.en: I swim through lava, sparks trailing off my fins.

lines.zh: 岩浆比水稠，我划得慢些。
lines.en: Lava is thicker than water, so I paddle slower.

lines.zh: 我沿着熔岩湖边走，找热的地方。
lines.en: I follow the lava shore, hunting for heat.

lines.zh: 三五个同伴在前头，我跟过去。
lines.en: Three or four companions lead; I fall in behind.

lines.zh: 我摆尾时，岩浆被推出一圈纹。
lines.en: My tail pushes rings across the molten rock.

lines.zh: 越靠近岩浆底，我越舒服。
lines.en: The closer I get to the lava floor, the better I feel.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆缝里钻过去，鳞发亮。
lines.en: I slip through a crack in the lava, scales bright.

lines.zh: 我不停地游，因为停下会凉。
lines.en: I never stop swimming; stopping makes me cold.

lines.zh: 我的身体把热吸进去，又吐出来。
lines.en: My body drinks the heat in and breathes it out.

lines.zh: 熔岩流带我走，我顺着漂。
lines.en: The lava current carries me and I drift with it.

lines.zh: 我和同伴挤在一起顺流而下。
lines.en: I crowd together with my kin and ride downstream.

lines.zh: 岩浆表面裂开，我钻了进去。
lines.en: The lava crust splits and I slip inside.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，火苗矮了一截。
lines.en: Where I pass, the flames burn a little lower.

lines.zh: 我沿着玄武岩壁，慢慢巡一圈。
lines.en: I cruise once around the basalt wall, slowly.

lines.zh: 我贴着熔岩底游，找凉一点的缝。
lines.en: I swim low over the lava bed, hunting a cooler crack.

lines.zh: 同伴散开，我跟着最大那条。
lines.en: The school scatters and I follow the biggest one.

lines.zh: 我钻过玄武岩柱之间，很快。
lines.en: I slip between basalt pillars, quick.

lines.zh: 岩浆卷起一小股，我借势冲。
lines.en: A small surge of lava lifts, and I ride it.

lines.zh: 我泡在岩浆里，像块烧红的石头。
lines.en: I soak in the lava like a stone heated red.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，热就够了。
lines.en: I do not eat; heat is enough for me.

lines.zh: 肚子从来不叫，这很省事。
lines.en: My stomach never growls, which is convenient.

lines.zh: 我在熔岩上漂着，火在身下烧。
lines.en: I float on the lava while fire burns beneath.

lines.zh: 我闭着眼，也能感到热在流。
lines.en: Eyes closed, I still feel the heat flowing.

lines.zh: 同伴在旁边吐着火星，很安静。
lines.en: My kin spit sparks beside me, quietly.

lines.zh: 岩浆冒泡，我就跟着晃一下。
lines.en: A lava bubble pops and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 我从不饿，所以从不着急。
lines.en: I am never hungry, so I am never in a hurry.

lines.zh: 热度低了，我往深处挪一点。
lines.en: When the heat drops, I shift a little deeper.

lines.zh: 我这一生，只关心够不够暖。
lines.en: All my life I care about is being warm enough.

lines.zh: 岩浆是我的床，也是我的饭。
lines.en: Lava is my bed and my meal at once.

lines.zh: 我在火里打了个盹，鳞片发亮。
lines.en: I doze in the fire and my scales shine.

lines.zh: 稀有得很，你遇见我算运气。
lines.en: I am rare, so meeting me is your good luck.

lines.zh: 我停在熔岩边，等热浪翻上来。
lines.en: I hover at the lava edge, waiting for a heat wave.

lines.zh: 你站在岩浆边，脸上映着红光。
lines.en: You stand at the lava edge, your face lit red.

lines.zh: 我隔着热浪看你，你的影子在抖。
lines.en: I watch you through the heat; your shadow wavers.

lines.zh: 你拿桶的手离岩浆好近。
lines.en: The hand holding your bucket is very near the lava.

lines.zh: 你的钓竿伸过来，线快烧断了。
lines.en: Your rod reaches out and the line is nearly burnt.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，想你会不会跳下来。
lines.en: I stare at you, wondering if you will jump in.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我知道你怕烫。
lines.en: You step back; I know you fear the heat.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在冒烟，我有点想笑。
lines.en: Your boots are smoking and I almost laugh.

lines.zh: 我看你时，眼睛像两粒火炭。
lines.en: When I look at you, my eyes are two coals.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，热浪把你的汗逼出来。
lines.en: You crouch and the heat wave forces out your sweat.

lines.zh: 你身上有股冷味，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You carry a cold smell that I do not like.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，火星溅了一地。
lines.en: One hit from you and sparks scatter everywhere.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，一下就到头。
lines.en: I have one point of health; one blow finishes it.

lines.zh: 我的鳞裂了，热从缺口漏出。
lines.en: My scales crack and heat leaks from the gap.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打进岩浆深处。
lines.en: That knocks me deep into the lava.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，我吸的热全散了。
lines.en: When it hurts, all the heat I stored scatters.

lines.zh: 别打，我身上还在冒烟。
lines.en: Stop; I am still smoking.

lines.zh: 我在火里翻了个身，差点灭。
lines.en: I roll over in the fire and nearly go out.

lines.zh: 伤口边缘在冒泡，很烫。
lines.en: The edges of my wound bubble and burn.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，火星落进水里。
lines.en: I shake and sparks drop into the water.

lines.zh: 痛感像被浇了一勺冷水。
lines.en: The pain feels like a ladle of cold water.

lines.zh: 你手里的岩浆桶，让我游近了。
lines.en: The lava bucket in your hand draws me closer.

lines.zh: 那点热靠近，我忍不住跟过去。
lines.en: That heat comes near and I cannot help following.

lines.zh: 你把火把放低，我就贴上去。
lines.en: You lower the torch and I press right up to it.

lines.zh: 我不馋饵，只馋你手里的温度。
lines.en: I do not want bait, only the warmth in your hand.

lines.zh: 那团热光一晃，我忘了躲。
lines.en: That hot glow sways and I forget to hide.

lines.zh: 你的火把太暖，我绕了三圈。
lines.en: Your torch is so warm I circle it three times.

lines.zh: 只要够烫，我就愿意靠近。
lines.en: If it is hot enough, I am willing to come close.

lines.zh: 岩浆味飘过来，我的鳍张开了。
lines.en: The smell of lava drifts over and my fins spread.

lines.zh: 你把热源放进水里，我立刻过去。
lines.en: You put a heat source in the water and I go at once.

lines.zh: 我不吃饭，可我会追着热跑。
lines.en: I do not eat, but I will chase heat anywhere.

lines.zh: 你碰我一下，我身上掉下火星。
lines.en: One touch from you and sparks fall off me.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，撞了就见底。
lines.en: I have one point of health; a bump finishes me.

lines.zh: 我的身子小，撞你像碰石壁。
lines.en: I am small; hitting you is like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 水流一推，我在岩浆里翻了圈。
lines.en: The current shoves me and I roll in the lava.

lines.zh: 别踩，我就在你脚边的火里。
lines.en: Do not step; I am in the fire by your feet.

lines.zh: 你的靴子烫过来，我赶紧让开。
lines.en: Your hot boot comes over and I hurry aside.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞出熔岩流。
lines.en: That knocks me clean out of the lava stream.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里打了个滚，鳞还热。
lines.en: I roll in your shadow, my scales still hot.

lines.zh: 我的鳍歪了，火苗也偏了。
lines.en: My fin bends and the flames lean with it.

lines.zh: 一碰之下，我吸的热散了一半。
lines.en: At one touch, half the heat I stored drains away.

lines.zh: 我们三五条挤在一起，火连成片。
lines.en: Three or four of us huddle and the fire spreads.

lines.zh: 它的鳞比我的红，我贴过去。
lines.en: Its scales are redder than mine; I press closer.

lines.zh: 熔岩里没有巢，只有够热的地方。
lines.en: No nest in lava, only places hot enough.

lines.zh: 我们绕成一个圈，尾巴碰尾巴。
lines.en: We circle until tail meets tail.

lines.zh: 我给它让了块最烫的石头。
lines.en: I give it the hottest stone I know.

lines.zh: 两条小鱼在火里并排漂着。
lines.en: Two small fish drift side by side in the fire.

lines.zh: 我们同时吐出一串火星。
lines.en: We breathe out a string of sparks together.

lines.zh: 它游过来，我身上的热高了。
lines.en: It swims over and the heat in me rises.

lines.zh: 岩浆流把我们冲向同一处。
lines.en: The lava current sweeps us both to the same spot.

lines.zh: 它走了，我跟着它那点红光。
lines.en: It leaves, and I follow its small red glow.

lines.zh: 你把我舀进桶，桶壁立刻发烫。
lines.en: You scoop me in and the bucket wall goes hot.

lines.zh: 桶里的水嘶嘶响，我有点抱歉。
lines.en: The water hisses and I feel a little sorry.

lines.zh: 这么小的桶，装我刚好，就是烫。
lines.en: A bucket this small fits me, though it is hot.

lines.zh: 我在桶里发光，照见你的手。
lines.en: I glow in the bucket and light up your hand.

lines.zh: 桶底很快热了，我贴着它。
lines.en: The bottom heats fast and I press against it.

lines.zh: 你别把桶放下，会烧着木板。
lines.en: Do not set the bucket down; it will scorch the wood.

lines.zh: 我撞桶壁，声音闷闷的。
lines.en: I bump the bucket wall and the sound is muffled.

lines.zh: 桶盖一扣，里面的红慢慢暗了。
lines.en: The lid snaps shut and the red inside dims.

lines.zh: 你提着我走，桶一直冒白气。
lines.en: You carry me off and the bucket keeps steaming.

lines.zh: 我成了你手里一小团不肯灭的火。
lines.en: I am a stubborn little fire in your hand.

lines.zh: 前面有股热，我朝那边游。
lines.en: There is heat ahead, so I swim that way.

lines.zh: 一个发烫的小东西落下来，我盯着。
lines.en: Something hot drops in and I fix my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 那团红在动，我要过去看看。
lines.en: That red thing is moving; I want a look.

lines.zh: 熔岩在那边流，我认准了方向。
lines.en: The lava flows over there; I pick my direction.

lines.zh: 我闻到硫磺味，就往深处去。
lines.en: I smell sulfur and head deeper.

lines.zh: 水里冒泡的地方，一定有热。
lines.en: Where the water bubbles, there must be heat.

lines.zh: 那点火星不像鱼，我靠过去。
lines.en: That spark is no fish; I move toward it.

lines.zh: 我锁定了最烫的那片岩浆。
lines.en: I have picked out the hottest stretch of lava.

lines.zh: 热浪一推，我顺势游向源头。
lines.en: A heat wave pushes me toward its source.

lines.zh: 目标就是暖，我从不找别的。
lines.en: My only target is warmth; I seek nothing else.

lines.zh: 我一点点靠近那团热。
lines.en: I edge closer to that knot of heat.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，鳍张到最大。
lines.en: I circle it with my fins spread wide.

lines.zh: 再近些，我就能感到烫了。
lines.en: A little closer and I will feel the burn.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩浆面，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I skim the lava surface and inch along.

lines.zh: 它没动，我先停下观察。
lines.en: It does not move, so I stop and watch.

lines.zh: 我一动，水面就冒起白烟。
lines.en: When I move, white smoke rises off the water.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过去，热量吸得更快。
lines.en: I turn sideways so the heat soaks in faster.

lines.zh: 周围太冷，我只想钻进那点红。
lines.en: It is too cold here; I only want into that red.

lines.zh: 它晃了一下，我立刻跟上。
lines.en: It sways once and I follow immediately.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我冲进热里。
lines.en: Close enough; I dive into the heat.

lines.zh: 我用头撞它，像丢出一颗火星。
lines.en: I headbutt it like throwing a single spark.

lines.zh: 我这一下只有一点力道。
lines.en: This blow of mine carries one point of force.

lines.zh: 我咬它，牙被烫得发麻。
lines.en: I bite it and the heat numbs my teeth.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，自己被弹回岩浆。
lines.en: I lunge and get bounced back into the lava.

lines.zh: 撞完我自己也晕，鳞还在冒烟。
lines.en: The hit dizzies me too, my scales still smoking.

lines.zh: 我这么小，凶起来也就这样。
lines.en: I am this small, so this is as fierce as I get.

lines.zh: 我贴着它烧了一下，它没反应。
lines.en: I sear against it and it does not even react.

lines.zh: 一下两下，我连皮都没咬破。
lines.en: Once, twice, and I never break its skin.

lines.zh: 我冲过去，把热全拍在它身上。
lines.en: I rush in and slap all my heat onto it.

lines.zh: 打完我就游开，怕被抓住。
lines.en: When it is done I swim off, afraid of being caught.

lines.zh: 我从下界的岩浆里冒出来。
lines.en: I surface out of the Nether's lava.

lines.zh: 火一翻，我和四条同伴一起出现。
lines.en: The fire rolls and I appear with four companions.

lines.zh: 熔岩湖裂开，我们就这么来了。
lines.en: The lava lake cracks open and here we are.

lines.zh: 我出生在一池滚烫的红里。
lines.en: I was born in a pool of scalding red.

lines.zh: 下界的热风把我吹到水面。
lines.en: The Nether's hot wind blows me to the surface.

lines.zh: 我们三五条，一起从火里钻出。
lines.en: Three or five of us come up out of the fire.

lines.zh: 没有谁叫我，是岩浆把我推上来。
lines.en: No one called me; the lava pushed me up.

lines.zh: 我第一口呼吸，全是硫磺味。
lines.en: My first breath is all sulfur.

lines.zh: 熔岩退了一点，我露了出来。
lines.en: The lava recedes a little and there I am.

lines.zh: 我的出生地，是一座活的火湖。
lines.en: My birthplace is a living lake of fire.

lines.zh: 火对我来说只是更暖一点。
lines.en: Fire is only a little more warmth to me.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，我摔得直冒烟。
lines.en: Falling from a height, I land smoking.

lines.zh: 泡在水里，我竟然透不过气。
lines.en: Soaked in water, I cannot breathe at all.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀出熔岩，鳞冷得快。
lines.en: The blast throws me from the lava, scales cooling fast.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我，热从洞里跑掉。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and heat escapes the hole.

lines.zh: 紫光一照，我吸的热全被抽空。
lines.en: Violet light falls and drains every bit of my heat.

lines.zh: 我从不吃饭，可这词还是让我慌。
lines.en: I never eat, yet that word still unsettles me.

lines.zh: 雷打进熔岩，整池火都在震。
lines.en: Lightning hits the lava and the whole pool shakes.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有热，我开始僵硬。
lines.en: There is no heat in the void and I start to stiffen.
